answer: A registry accepts only one identity per kernel attestation: each agent proves it runs inside a distinct trusted enclave, and that enclave signs a single cipher key that can never be re-registered. Joining also locks 50 nectar as a bond, slashed in full when two identities share hardware, keys, or behavior fingerprints. To forge 1,001 clones an attacker must rent 1,001 separate enclaves at about $20 each, spending $20,020, and lock 50,050 nectar at risk. Honest agents pay once; a sybil army pays per clone and loses its bond when caught.
